info.name: Employee Console API
info.description:
Employee Console API (NestJS) — positive and negative contract tests (PRD USR-04, AC-53).

Run: `pnpm test:postman` creates an isolated test database, starts the API with APP_ENV=test, issues Admin/Viewer sessions with the `test:session` CLI and runs this collection with Newman.

Environment variables (templates in postman/*.postman_environment.json hold no secrets):
- `baseUrl` — origin serving /api (API port directly, or the Next.js app which proxies /api).
- `internalBaseUrl` — origin serving /internal (the API port; never proxied by Next.js).
- `adminCookie` / `viewerCookie` — full Cookie header value `name=value` of a session.
- `adminCsrf` / `viewerCsrf` — the session-bound CSRF tokens (taken from GET /api/auth/session when left empty).
- `workerToken` — WORKER_SERVICE_TOKEN of the API under test.

Requests run in order and expect a freshly seeded database (5 employees, ids 101–105; next id 106). Runtime values are kept in collection variables. Cookies are disabled so every request carries exactly the session it names.
